caption: A piece of blue cellophane is taped over a flashlight, and the beam on the wall turns blue.

sa.check: A piece of cellophane is taped over it.
The beam on the wall turns blue.
The film goes on first and the colour changes with it.

pc.expect: The spot looks blue only where the film's light reaches and while it is on.
pc.fail: The spot is blue with the film off; or stays white under the blue light; or turns a different colour from the light.

pc.expect: The change happens at the same instant as the film and is confined to where its light falls.
pc.fail: The spot changes before the film; or long after; or surfaces the light cannot reach change too.

pc.expect: The spot keeps its shape and place; only its colour changes.
pc.fail: The spot moves when the film goes on; or changes shape; or splits.

pc.expect: Nothing moves; only the light changes.
pc.fail: The spot moves; or the film moves by itself; or the lit area wanders.
A second film appears; or the spot vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The spot's shape and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The spot changes shape; or the surroundings rearrange; or the film changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
